gradient_clipping: Clip source core/dictionary and classification readout separately at the same threshold. Detached source updates cannot depend on classification gradient magnitude through a shared clip factor.
scope: Train-source category attribution screen; fixed recording splits, 0/1/2 targets only. No backbone, quantity, TabM, waveform frontend, source mixtures or test-noise changes.
initialization: Reset new estimators from common seed13; same Train dictionary and frequency scaling from SourceComponent cache, no reuse of its selected R2/R3 task weights. H1 frozen task-trained feature and quantity paths are retained.
training_division: All arms have a common three-epoch source-core warmup. Classification readout is trained on detached activations during warmup. After epoch3 P0/P1 allow classification gradients into the activation core; P2/P3/P4 keep a detach seam. Source objectives always train the core. No extra training stage or epoch search.
dictionary_attribution: Only P1/P3/P4 train nonnegative normalized dictionaries. For each present known Train component, fit its normalized mean spectrum with every candidate group for eight KL coefficient updates; use true-group contrast CE plus an initial-dictionary anchor. This uses Train source targets only, not any Val/Test source or true labels at prediction.
selection: One trained checkpoint per arm (epoch>=1), maximizing .5 original Val ACC+.5 five-noisy-Val mean ACC, tie original Val. Epoch0 kept separately. Same checkpoint for all six Test conditions; held-out source diagnostics only after sealing.
decision: Report attribution, gradient division and unfolding separately. Do not force all mechanisms to succeed together. Require better held-out class components than zero and a matched ordinary predictor, controlled absent activation and corresponding recognition gain before advancing. No automatic quantity adaptation.
